title: Local vehicle record
description: logs/vehicle.json: the local vehicle id (vid), created once by openostler.logbook.vehicle (UI spec §4.1, U0). It never holds a VIN or any identity read from the car. OSTLER_VEHICLE_ID overrides the vid without changing the file.

vid.description: Vehicle id: names one vehicle, not a pack (UI spec §4.1). Same rule as session-meta vid.

pack.description: The id of the vehicle pack active when the record was created (lr_d2), or null with none installed.

created_utc.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a Z suffix.
